old=file.read_text()
new='''def transform(grid):
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    above = [v for row in grid[:divider] for v in row if v in (2, 4)]
    below = [v for row in grid[divider + 1:] for v in row if v in (2, 4)]
    counts_above = {color: above.count(color) for color in (2, 4)}
    counts_below = {color: below.count(color) for color in (2, 4)}
    change = {color: abs(counts_below[color] - counts_above[color]) for color in (2, 4)}
    color = 2 if change[2] >= change[4] else 4
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
'''
assert old.count('lower =') == 1
file.write_text(new)
exec(compile(new,str(file),'exec'),globals())
print(transform(p1),transform(p2))
